Witch tax blocks bulk forgery. New identities pay a genesis tax. Every identity files a lantern record.

Tax is 90 units. Observation lasts 4 epochs. Honest work refunds 15% per epoch. Forgery burns the remaining tax. Freeze lasts 8 epochs. A vine check links referrals to the tax roll.

Cost math: 1,000 clones pay 90,000 units first. A 30% detection rate burns 27,000 units. The crystal ledger shows tax payments. Bulk forgery loses money.
